svg.title: English-learning video production workflow
svg.desc: An iterative production workflow: the user reviews dialogue and either requests revisions or approves production; audio and visual assets are generated and reviewed, individual parts can be revised with dependent outputs regenerated and rechecked, and the approved package proceeds through validation and authenticated YouTube publishing.

g.text: 1 · Choose profile, topic & confirm facts
Check level, episode catalog, setting, roles, rules, and source facts
2 · Draft structured dialogue
Learner text · TTS text · speaker turns · scene assignments
3 · Review and revise dialogue
Facts · scene logic · naturalness · level fit · coherent resolution
User decides: dialogue ready?
Approve to continue · request changes to loop back to dialogue
4 · Generate the episode package
Speech: per-line and merged TTS audio · measured timings
Learning & visuals: learning cards · referenced scene images · manifests
YouTube assets: thumbnail · title · description
5 · Keep episode assets traceable
Episode folder owns dialogue, audio, timings, images, manifests, and metadata.
Shared Remotion source provides reusable scenes and composition behavior.
Edits trigger regeneration and review of dependent outputs.
Optional · Worksheets when requested
Generate Free/Pro PDFs · inspect text and rendered pages · publish via R2/D1
Cloudflare Worker provides the PDF download route
6 · Compose, preview, revise, and render
Remotion template aligns dialogue, audio, scene timing, cards, and phase timeline
7 · Run package and artifact checks
check-package verifies files, schemas, timing, assets, metadata, and render inputs
PDF checks apply only when the PDF option is enabled
User reviews each part and the final output
Request edits to any part · regenerate dependent outputs · review again
Approve publishing only when all required artifacts and checks pass
8 · Publish approved video
Authenticated YouTube API · upload only after explicit human approval
9 · Verify delivery and record the result
Confirm requested public output and downloads; update the episode catalog
REVISE DIALOGUE
EDIT PART · REGENERATE DEPENDENCIES · REVIEW AGAIN
